description: Alpha Agent Stage 6 — historical backfill & experiment-readiness. Bounded, resumable, point-in-time-safe acquisition through EXISTING owned providers (Priority 1: Norgate local, survivorship-aware) to unlock the first REAL Stage 5 experiments, plus a deterministic Stage 1 reopening lane. ACQUISITION + READINESS only: never creates orders, fills, signals, trade decisions, model promotions, portfolio or Alpha Paper Book changes, Paper Trader DB writes, Daily Close triggers, prediction-service calls or PostgreSQL access; never installs a package; never executes LLM-authored code. available_at is preserved as observed and NEVER fabricated; a fiscal period-end is NEVER substituted for a public-availability date. Contains NO secret — no credential value appears anywhere.

eodhd.gap_detail: EODHD owned entitlement returns a current General/Highlights snapshot, not lookahead-free point-in-time quarterly history with per-period filing/availability dates; acquiring it as history would risk period-end lookahead and is therefore held, not approximated.

sec_edgar.gap_detail: SEC EDGAR daily-index acquisition is bounded to a recent window in Stage 2; a full 2015+ Form-4/filing backfill is a larger bounded job scheduled separately and is reported here as a remaining gap, not approximated.
